Improve Your Insights and Power Your Productivity with AI
VIP's Advanced AI Features Include:
Turn every call into a searchable, shareable summary.
Crexendo AI transcribes and summarizes recorded calls, including speaker labels, timestamps, sentiment analysis, and more.
With AI Call Summaries * you can:
Eliminate manual note-taking — review call transcripts and summaries anytime
Improve documentation of key conversations with customers and teammates
Evaluate customer service and agent performance with sentiment and speaker insights
Share call highlights and summaries with participants via email
Make every meeting count — without taking notes.
How it works: AI listens to your recorded meetings and delivers a smart summary with key points, speaker breakdowns, tone analysis, and more.
With AI Meeting Summaries * you can:
Automatically generate transcripts and highlights from audio and video meetings
Review discussions by topic, speaker, or sentiment after the meeting
Send concise summaries and action items to participants
Maintain a searchable archive of your meeting history
Professional audio content — generated and scheduled in minutes.
How it works: Voice AI Studio uses your website to create customized on-hold and auto attendant messages, complete with royalty-free music and voice options.
With Voice AI Studio you can:
Instantly create and schedule professional on-hold and greeting messages
Promote timely offers, seasonal content, or service updates through custom audio
Automate holiday switching — return to regular messaging without lifting a finger
Get a Demo of VIP's Advanced AI Capabilities

Platform built on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) with Ultimate Reliability, Security, and Compliance

Trusted by Over 300,000 Organizations and 8 Million Users
Provides peace of mind with our 100% Uptime Guarantee*
